# Copilot instructions

## Repo purpose

This repository contains the Estadio web project, built as a content-heavy PHP site around the Estadio de Gran Canaria book and related editorial material.

## Workflow rules

- Work on `dev`, not on `main`, unless explicitly asked.
- Prefer conservative edits.
- Do not modernize the whole project at once.
- Do not move or rename large content trees unless required.

## Editing rules

- Respect the editorial and historical nature of the content.
- Preserve existing routes and page structure.
- Treat media-heavy folders carefully.
- Prefer gradual improvements in readability, maintainability and front-end hygiene.

## Validation

Before finishing, check:

- internal links still work
- includes and page paths still resolve
- no content sections were accidentally removed
- visual changes remain compatible with the current structure
